# BRW-01 Run 1 — supplied image "V1" (formal Run-1 review is NOT complete: only one of four variants received)

**Provenance:** externally generated by the founder with ChatGPT image generation (references/strength not reported), 2000x1121, saved as `BRW-01-R1-V1.webp`. No retouching. Founder approval: NO. Run 2 is not authorised; the other three Run-1 variants are still needed for the formal Run-1 review (D-48).

## Hard count gate (counted twice at 1.5x-2x)
| Count | Result |
|---|---|
| Fermenters | **6** both times. Left of deck: 3 (far-left, second, third beside the deck). Right of deck: 3 (tank east of the deck, a partly hidden one behind it, and the large nearest tank at the right edge). **PASS** |
| Copper brewing vessels | **2** under one copper hood and stack, no other copper tanks. **PASS** |

## Mandatory gates
| Gate | Result |
|---|---|
| Recognisable horseshoe, not a straight row | **FAIL / weak.** Tanks 1-3 stand in a near-straight row across the back, parallel to the picture plane, level with the deck. There is no west leg receding northward, and the camera reads nearly frontal. Only the right group gains depth. The blockout's oblique fan-out was not followed |
| Graphite cones | PASS (dark matte); slightly brown where they reflect warm light |
| Exactly six narrow deep-marigold sleeves | Six present. Colour is a saturated red-orange (sampled about (219-247, 101-118, 2-5), deeper/redder than #E8870E, not yellow). The nearest tank's sleeve is thick (about 15-16 % of the diameter, about 9-10 in), so **PARTIAL** |
| Raised deck, stairs, 42-in guardrails, catwalk | PASS (catwalk at upper level with railings; stairs on the deck's left) |
| Sanitary piping, tri-clamps/valves, pumps, restrained hoses, legs/foot plates, side manways | PASS on detail; piping is dense, scaffold-like and over-busy; a brewer might question it |
| Trench drains | PASS (two visible; the grating looks slightly decorative) |
| Satin warm-grey floor | **FAIL.** Glossy polished floor with long lamp reflections; reads showroom |
| Evening exposure, no orange wash | **FAIL.** Overall mean RGB about (120,82,53); walls and stainless are amber/gold, so stainless does not read neutral; the cool fill only appears in the windows |
| No clipping | PARTIAL: about 2.6 % of pixels at >= 250 (lamps and highlights) |
| No glass reflections / no daylight sky | **FAIL (borderline).** Tall north windows show saturated cobalt sky and detailed trees, brighter than the "faint indigo" intended; a dark frame/mullion also cuts the right edge |
| No people, text, numerals, logos | PASS. No flares, bloom, haze. Small ceiling track spots are tolerable but not requested |

## Score (strict)
Tank Cloister correctness 17/25, equipment realism 15/20, continuity with ARC-01-D / Locked DNA / blockout camera 10/15, lighting and materials 8/15, photorealism 11/15, restraint 4/5, "they make it here" feel 3/5 = **68/100**.
**Hard fails:** orange wash; glossy showroom floor; straight-row/near-frontal arrangement; bright daytime-looking sky and trees in the windows; camera not the approved oblique.

## Verdict
**V1 FAILS** (68, hard fails), despite the correct count of six tanks and two copper vessels, which is the first time a generator has held that count. Equipment detail is strong. Per D-48 it must not be accepted or retouched. Still needed: the other three Run-1 variants, then a formal Run-1 review before Run 2 is considered. If kept as a partial lead, its strengths are the six/two count, graphite cones, deck/stairs/pumps/hose, and trench drains.
